name: Ring of golden waxcaps 015
prompt: a circle of toadstools growing as a fairy ring on bare trodden forest soil, ring of golden waxcaps, with thick exposed roots, tiny, only ankle-high, completely unlit, no glow, no light sources, no self-emission

placement.note: ONE SCENERY PIXEL IS ONE PLAYER PIXEL. world_px_height IS the art's own alpha bbox height, so scenery is placed into the world at 1:1 exactly as the avatar is (setScale(1)) and the two share one pixel grid. The CAMERA still zooms the whole scene — that is uniform and correct; what must never happen is scenery being resampled on its own, against the player. world_height_m is what the art reads as beside a 87px character; declared_height_m is what it was once declared to be, and a gap between them means the ART is the wrong size.

LIT_2.glow_concept: glowing mycelium threads linking the toadstools underground

motion.description: This is an almost completely still picture. ONLY the outermost edge of the cyan threads under the mushrooms changes, and barely: a few pixels along that edge lift very slightly in brightness and drop straight back. They stay exactly the cyan they are in the first frame and are equally visible in every frame. Every leaf, every stem and every branch is copied from the first frame exactly: not one of them moves, bends, shifts, grows or changes shape or colour at any point. Frames 1, 2 and 5 are identical to each other. Only frames 3 and 4 differ at all, and only by a handful of pixels. Everything else is copied from the first frame exactly, pixel for pixel. The last frame matches the first exactly.

NOT_LIT_5.glow_concept: every cap lit from inside like paper lanterns

light.reference: the spawn bonfire is 1.0 (radius 7); strength 0 is no light
